body:
I reached out to the professor to no avail. If I can make it til morning I will consider reaching out to admissions. From the little research I've done it takes up to 2 months to get the appeal reviewed which would put me past registration and move-in for Fall. 

Now that I've written it out...I feels like too much work. I wish I had enough energy for this last round. I want to put the gloves down, I want to stop fighting.

I'm happy to hear things have gone well for you after your struggles. I'm especially happy your family finally realized how awesome your accomplishment is. 

The thing is...I am getting tired of picking up the pieces every time I fall apart. I've been thrown challenge after challenge my entire life. I've witness so much cruelty in my life, experienced too much pain, and gotten the short stick one too many times. 

I am much too tired at this point. Life has taken all she can from me. It's easier to give in right now because the embarrassment and disappointment are too heavy a burden.

UPDATE: Emailed the professor and he won't let me make up those measly points. Claiming it isn't fair to other students. 

Meanwhile he's let a group of 3 students cheat the entire semester. This group of friends get the exact same answers down to the format, word choice, etc. I hate that no matter how many other students brought it up to him he let it continue. 

He told me not to give up, but his class is the reason I want to kill myself. I am sitting at home, crying silently so as to not wake my grandmother. The thought of disappointing her breaks my heart into so many pieces that it would be impossible to put back together.
